D: Dumbledore sends Newt and a small team to stop Grindelwald from taking over the wizarding world.
P: Serve dessert when Jacob and Queenie get married at the bakery.
S: Soft pretzels dipped in bicarb water, topped with rock salt
Soft pretzels shaped and boiled in bicarb water, rock salt on top, baked at 220C for 12 minutes, with grainy mustard and butter.
Hog's Head sausage rolls and brown sauce

Sausage rolls of pork, onion and sage in puff pastry, baked at 200C for 25 minutes, with brown sauce. Mix 500g pork mince with 1 grated onion, 1 tbsp chopped sage, 40g breadcrumbs, 1 tsp salt and plenty of pepper. Halve 2 sheets puff pastry lengthways. Lay a log of the filling down each strip, roll up and seal the seam with beaten egg. Cut each log into 4, brush with egg and score the tops. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until puffed and golden. Serve hot with brown sauce.
Steamed chicken and ginger dumplings with a charred tomato chilli sauce
Chicken and spring onion dumplings with ginger, steamed 10 minutes, with a chilli tomato dip.
M: Panko crumbed pork loin fried in butter, warm potato salad
Pork loin steaks pounded thin, crumbed in egg and panko, fried in butter until golden, with a warm potato salad and lemon.

Polish-style pierogi of potato and cheese, boiled then fried in butter with onions, with sour cream. Mix 300g plain flour, 1 egg, 125ml warm water, 2 tbsp sour cream and a pinch of salt into a soft dough, knead 3 minutes and rest 30 minutes. Mash 500g boiled potatoes with 100g grated cheddar and 1 onion fried in butter. Roll the dough thin, cut 7cm rounds, fill and pinch closed. Boil in batches until they float, then 2 minutes more. Fry 2 sliced onions in 60g butter until golden, add the pierogi to crisp and serve with sour cream and dill.
W: Three butter sponge layers with buttercream and raspberry jam, iced
Vanilla sponge baked in three tins at 175C for 25 minutes, stacked with buttercream and raspberry jam, iced white.
K: Fresh raspberry puree in a flute, topped up with bubbles

Raspberries crushed with lemon and a little sugar, topped with cold sparkling wine in flutes. Sparkling apple juice for the non-drinkers. Crush 125g raspberries with 1 tbsp caster sugar and the juice of half a lemon, then push through a sieve to remove the seeds. Spoon 1 tbsp of the purée into each of 4 flutes. Slowly top with cold sparkling wine from a 750ml bottle, letting the foam settle as you pour. Drop a whole raspberry into each glass. For non-drinkers, use sparkling apple juice.

s.note: Soft pretzels dipped in bicarb water, topped with rock salt
s.how: Mix 500g flour, 7g yeast and 300ml warm water to a dough and rest an hour. Shape into pretzels, dip in boiling water with 2 tbsp bicarb soda and sprinkle with rock salt. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Serve with butter and wholegrain mustard.

s.note: Steamed chicken and ginger dumplings with a charred tomato chilli sauce
s.how: Mix 400g chicken mince with sliced spring onion and grated ginger. Fill dumpling wrappers, pleat and steam for 10 minutes. Char 3 tomatoes in a dry pan and blitz with chilli flakes and salt for a dipping sauce.

m.note: Panko crumbed pork loin fried in butter, warm potato salad
m.how: Pound 4 pork loin steaks thin, then crumb in flour, beaten egg and panko. Fry in butter until golden on both sides. Boil 800g potatoes, slice and toss warm with a little vinegar, oil and salt. Serve the schnitzel with lemon wedges.

w.note: Three butter sponge layers with buttercream and raspberry jam, iced
w.how: Beat 300g butter with 300g sugar, add 5 eggs and fold in 300g self-raising flour. Bake in 3 tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Stack with buttercream and raspberry jam and ice white with icing sugar beaten into butter. Fit for a bakery wedding.

d.note: Fresh raspberry puree in a flute, topped up with bubbles
d.how: Crush 125g raspberries with 1 tbsp caster sugar and the juice of half a lemon, then push through a sieve to remove the seeds. Spoon 1 tbsp of the purée into each of 4 flutes. Slowly top with cold sparkling wine from a 750ml bottle, letting the foam settle as you pour. Drop a whole raspberry into each glass. For non-drinkers, use sparkling apple juice.
